Devon —

Appreciate the clear ask. I've attached a working MAP (Helios_MAP_v2.xlsx) that maps technical evaluation milestones to procurement checkpoints and decision gates. Key notes up front:
- We recommend 6 milestones across a 6–8 week eval: sandbox access, workload baseline, perf baseline, security sign-off, pilot deployment, final validation.
- Each milestone includes an owner (Helios or Redwood), a pass/fail criterion, and an associated procurement trigger (PO request, legal review, SOC evidence).
- For exec briefing (EB): we can run a 45-minute session. Week of Sept 6–10 we have limited senior availability; suggested windows: Sept 7 10:00–11:00 PDT or Sept 9 15:00–15:45 PDT. I've exported proposed windows as EB_proposed_windows.ics.

Marissa (CS) will own the EB logistics and Priyom will be the technical lead on the MAP items.

High-level next steps:
1) Devon to confirm preferred EB window and attendee list (titles/time zones).
2) We finalize MAP owners and version; Helios to sign off on milestones.
3) Redwood to hand off calendar invite + EB prep notes and one-page exec brief.

Brief note on procurement questions: we included suggested legal/PO checkpoints in the MAP but are happy to adapt.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Markus Klein
